summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a director/PDMR share disposal. Jayne Opperman, CEO of Consumer Lending, sold 1,242,439 ordinary shares of 10p each in aggregate at an average price of GBP 1.034771 per share on 15 June 2026. The transactions were executed on the London Stock Exchange. The filing is a routine notification of a PDMR's share sale and does not reflect any corporate special situation such as a tender offer, going-private transaction, or capital return. It is simply a regulatory disclosure under the Market Abuse Regulation as part of standard compliance.
